options.content: KPI symulacji RF + mesh. **Delivery** = udział udanych prób `link_attempt`. **Rebroadcast** = obciążenie przekaźników (meshtasticd). Szczegóły tras: dashboard *Routing i ścieżki*.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> count()

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "link_attempt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> count()

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "link_attempt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> group(columns: ["delivered"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> reduce(
      identity: {total: 0, ok: 0},
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
        total: accumulator.total + r._value,
        ok: if r.delivered == "True" then accumulator.ok + r._value else accumulator.ok,
      }),
    )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: if r.total > 0 then float(v: r.ok) / float(v: r.total) * 100.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group()

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id" or (r._field == "is_rebroadcast" and r._value == true))
  |> reduce(
      identity: {total: 0, reb: 0},
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
        total: if r._field == "packet_id" then accumulator.total + 1 else accumulator.total,
        reb: if r._field == "is_rebroadcast" then accumulator.reb + 1 else accumulator.reb,
      }),
    )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: if r.total > 0 then float(v: r.reb) / float(v: r.total) * 100.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group()

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "simulation_run")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: int(v: r.node_count))}))
  |> group()

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "link_attempt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.delivered == "True")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rssi_db")

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "link_attempt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packet_ota_tx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> group(columns: ["portnum"])
  |> count()
  |> group()

from(bucket: "meshtastic_sim")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "link_attempt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario_id =~ /${scenario_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.experiment_id =~ /${experiment_id:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.delivered == "True")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "packet_id")
  |> group(columns: ["tx_node", "rx_node"])
  |> count()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "liczba"})
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["liczba"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)
